extracted.name: Sriracha Pickled Eggs
extracted.description: These pickled eggs made with a Sriracha-based vinegar have a deliciously spicy kick in each bite! Perfect for a savory low-carb snack.
instruction_lines: Combine vinegar, water, onion, Sriracha sauce, and sea salt in a saucepan; bring to a simmer. Remove saucepan from heat and cool liquid slightly.
Place eggs in a 1-quart jar. Pour vinegar mixture over eggs. Seal the jar and refrigerate, occasionally shaking the jar, for at least 2 days.
